description: How the CLI prints. output.encoding: `auto` leaves a terminal to Python, and prints UTF-8 on a pipe whose encoding cannot write Chinese (cp1252 on Windows); `utf-8` always prints UTF-8; `native` never changes the encoding (a character it cannot show is printed as \uXXXX, never an error). Set `native` in cli.override.json when Chinese text shows as garbage; `doctor` prints a sample line so you can see which one reads right. output.format: `auto` prints text on a terminal and JSON on a pipe (an agent's script, a redirect); `json` or `text` always. `--json` on a command line always prints JSON; the commands only a person may run always print text.
